routes.name: Visa on Arrival (Pacific Islanders and exempt groups)
routes.summary: Passport holders from Pacific Island states get an Easy Visitor Visa on arrival, valid 60 days per visit. Diplomatic and official passports from China, Japan, Israel and Indonesia are also covered, plus Chinese ordinary passports on organized group tours.

other: Return ticket and completed arrival card.
Only at Jacksons International Airport and the Wutung land border.
Chinese ordinary passports only on group tours with a PNG-registered operator.

sources.label: ICSA news release 34/23, Visa on Arrival for Pacific countries

routes.name: Visitor eVisa
routes.summary: Most visitors apply online on the official PNG eVisa portal before travel, then complete the Digital Arrival Card. Visa classes, fees and stay lengths could not be read from the official pages, so they are not listed.

other: Fees and stay length not confirmed. Check the eVisa portal.

steps: Register on the PNG eVisa portal.
Pick the visa class and fill in the application.
Upload documents and pay the fee.
Get the decision by email, then complete the Digital Arrival Card.

routes.name: Employment Visa
routes.summary: Work visas in PNG are tied to an employer or sponsor, applied for through the eVisa system. The official work visa page redirected and could not be read, so rules and fees are not confirmed.

other: Requirements, fees and durations not confirmed.

routes.name: PNG citizenship
routes.summary: The Immigration and Citizenship Service Authority handles citizenship applications. Residence years, language rules and dual citizenship could not be confirmed from the pages we could read.

other: Residence years and dual citizenship rules not confirmed.
